name: anti-google-office
description: Browser extension that prevents Google Drive from opening Microsoft Office files in Google Docs, Sheets, or Slides and breaking their layout.

scripts.package:firefox: npm run build:firefox && web-ext build --source-dir dist/firefox --artifacts-dir web-ext-artifacts --filename firefox-addon.zip --overwrite-dest
scripts.package:chrome: npm run build:chrome && web-ext build --source-dir dist/chrome --artifacts-dir web-ext-artifacts --filename chrome-extension.zip --overwrite-dest
scripts.package:source: mkdir -p web-ext-artifacts && git archive --format=zip --output web-ext-artifacts/source-code.zip HEAD
scripts.preflight: npm run license:check && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format && npm test && npm run test:coverage && npm run build && npm run build:chrome && npm run package:firefox && npm run package:chrome
scripts.publish:firefox:listed: echo "Firefox store release is not configured yet."
scripts.publish:chrome: echo "Chrome Web Store release is not configured yet."
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.app.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.test.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.config.json
